name: Lowfin Companion
overview: Completion, resume, incremental cache, cover tags and Discord presence
description: Per-user completion rules and independent resume positions for Lowfin. Requires Jellyfin 12.2 or newer.

versions.changelog: Retain 250,000 incremental library changes and 32,768 queued item events. Durable checksummed append records, periodic atomic checkpoints, bounded-page reads, existing-cursor migration and incomplete-tail recovery preserve efficient offline catch-up.

Dashboard sidebar with the original Lowfin L, reorganized settings, optional per-user Discord presence with compatible gateway discovery, large READY support, encrypted token storage, cover rendering, uploads and persistent caching, live TV programme timing and no standalone import, plus Jellyfin 12.3 compatibility; minimum server version remains 12.2.
See the source repository CHANGELOG.md for this locally built version.
